project_summary: Headless fashion e-commerce store with fast product search

components.name: Product catalog and search
components.description: Product catalog with variants (size, colour), faceted search, typo tolerance and synonym handling, indexed from the product database in near real time.

components.name: Cart and checkout
components.description: Persistent cart, guest and registered checkout, address validation, shipping options and card payments with 3-D Secure through Stripe.

components.name: Next.js storefront
components.description: Server-rendered storefront with product listing and detail pages, image optimisation, SEO metadata and Core Web Vitals targets.

components.name: ERP inventory synchronisation
components.description: Bidirectional synchronisation of stock levels and orders with the client ERP through scheduled jobs and a reconciliation report.
